high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "techinsider." The post features a photograph of a person wearing a white hard hat and a high-visibility green jacket with reflective stripes. The individual appears to be working on or inspecting a large underwater cable that is being handled by a crane. The cable is coiled and extends upwards, with one end attached to a cylindrical device. In the background, there is a ship with various structures and equipment, indicating that the scene takes place at a port or a similar maritime location.
